purpose: Language capability map (W5). A language is only trusted to run real issues after the validation harness has proven it on synthetic fixtures. status: proven | untested. test_cmd/build_cmd are the defaults the harness and the fixer's detect_language_and_commands use; env_guarded means the harness needs that toolchain installed to run. markers/extensions are the detection signals detect_language_and_commands scores against.

python.notes: Only language genuinely exercised in production so far. Validation harness must re-prove it in CI before it counts again.

javascript.notes: Runs on the aquascope target; node toolchain needed.

typescript.notes: Configured in targets but no synthetic-fixture validation yet.

java.notes: Never run against a real issue; must pass the harness before enabling as a hunt target.
